gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-athiti: Conthrax has a wide-mouthed lowercase a and bodies so tall the capitals barely rise above them. Athiti follows in sans-serif, friendly and contemporary, with see-through s shapes and a high mean line.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-atkinson-hyperleg: Wide, geometric and tidy, Conthrax draws its t with crossbar and stem in one width, while Atkinson Hyperlegible has a low-key body. Text in the latter moves along smoothly, its s terminals set wide.

Approachable is the first word that fits Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, whose open counters breathe into the white space beneath Conthrax's constant-pressure strokes. Their strongest quality is that stencil-like spacing.
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next reads with big, open lowercase eyes. Under Conthrax's plain constant-width lines, a long passage would flow as one unbroken thread, its unlatched rounds never clogging.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-biryani: Biryani gives every e a large, clear eye and draws its sans-serif strokes with no thick-to-thin shift at all. Conthrax stands above it, wide and geometric, as the bolder voice.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-blinker: Blinker reads easily, its lowercase filling most of the height and its apertures wide. Conthrax makes a clean display partner for that sans, and their strongest quality is the shared, uniform line thickness.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic brings a high-set x-height and modern polish. A longer passage would read smoothly in it, since Conthrax above keeps curves free of any weight shift.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Conthrax's joins are as heavy as its strokes, giving it a solid, geometric footing. Carrois Gothic SC follows in sans-serif, with open curve endings and capitals that sit close to the lowercase height.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-chivo: Conthrax bends its lines like rope or tubing, wide and geometric. Chivo takes over below, packing lowercase up toward the caps, with visible daylight through every curve, so a longer passage stays inviting.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-chocolate-classic: Conthrax runs on a monoweight skeleton, with a wide-mouthed a and lowercase that nearly matches its capitals in height. Chocolate Classical Sans is its plain sans partner, and Conthrax earns its keep big and short.
